_comment: The vertical cut, for phones: Reels, Shorts, TikTok, a story.
It is NOT the 16x9 script reflowed. That one sells the 40% hosting
discount; this one sells the GoDigital bundle, leads with Vesopa AI
speaking Bangla, and shows the site builder -- the three things the owner
asked a vertical advert to carry. Same voice, same pipeline, its own copy.
EVERY CLAIM IS CHECKED AGAINST THE LIVE OFFER. GODIGITAL is kind=bundle,
value 256 pence, requires_tld=site, grants starter for 1 month,
first_order_only=1, countries=BD. Driven end to end on the live basket on
2026-09-18: a .site at BDT 297 plus Starter monthly at BDT 893 came to
BDT 1,190, the code took BDT 809 off, and the total was BDT 381.00.
THIS ONE SPEAKS A PRICE, and the 16x9 script deliberately does not. The
reason it is safe here: 381 is not a price that drifts with a rate card --
it is what the bundle COSTS, pinned by the coupon itself, and the day the
offer ends the advert ends with it. The taka figure is also the whole
hook; an advert for a fixed-price bundle that will not say the price is
asking to be scrolled past.
The number is spoken as Bangla words -- তিনশো একাশি -- because a Bangla
voice reading '381' says it digit by digit. The screen carries ৳৩৮১ in
Bengali numerals, which is how the site itself writes money to a
Bangladeshi visitor.
The code is spoken as 'গো ডিজিটাল' for the same reason BANGLADESH40 is
spoken as Bangla words in the other script: a Bangla voice reading the
Latin string GODIGITAL spells it out letter by letter.

lines.say: ব্যবসা অনলাইনে আনবেন? এখন সবচেয়ে সহজ।

_note: The assistant is on every page of cloud.vesopa.com and it does speak
Bangla -- it is the same Vesopa AI the site ships, not a promise.
What it does NOT do is buy anything on your behalf without asking, so
the line says it finds and explains, which is what it actually does.
lines.say: ভেসোপা এ আই কে বাংলায় বলুন। ডোমেইন খুঁজে দেবে, হোস্টিং বুঝিয়ে দেবে।
আর ওয়েবসাইট? মুখে বলুন, চোখের সামনেই তৈরি হয়ে যাবে।
ডট সাইট ডোমেইন, সঙ্গে প্রথম মাসের হোস্টিং। দুটো মিলে মাত্র তিনশো একাশি টাকা।
কোড গো ডিজিটাল। ক্লাউড ডট ভেসোপা ডট কম।
